== English Virtual Original comparison ==
The early destiny response says a weapon, duel or lightsaber combat destiny targeting Obi-Wan. The 2006 keeps weapon destiny targeting Obi-Wan and separately requires participation for duel or lightsaber combat. The same three deploy/retrieve choices, Inner Strength and 1 Force costs remain.
